sources.snippet: High-Level Architecture The Bench2DriveZoo repository implements three main model architectures for autonomous driving, each with different capabilities and complexity levels. All models use camera inputs to generate Bird's Eye View (BEV) representations, but they differ in their downstream tasks and capabilities.
